name: Shiawase★Mille-Feuille ~Sora kara Futago ga Futtekita!!~
original_name: しあわせ★ミルフィーユ～そらからふたごがふってきた！！～
source:
In a small village not far away from the big city...
On the outskirts of said village, surrounded by sea and forest, there lives a single artist.

His name is Masaru. He draws under the penname Kasugano Shougo.

Even though he isn't the most famous of painters, his artistry is promising enough.
He has withdrawn from the tumult in town to relax and lets time dictate his path – the path to become a professional artist.

During one night, illuminated by beautiful moonlight, his life is about to change significantly.
Initiated by a shooting star... no, a meteorite?

While he's leisurely sipping on his teacup, suddenly an UFO comes crashing into his garden.

Said UFO evidently must contain extraterrestrial visitors, but he's baffled when they turn out to be two twin sisters.

Since the aliens would be entirely alone on earth and - to top it all off - they also look like toddlers, Masaru couldn't simply leave them to their fate and decides that he must assume the role as their foster parent.

And so he does: Masaru starts living together with world's strangest alien twin sisters and puts effort into raising them from mischievous little children into the ideal girls.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/mil/mf_top.htm]Official website[/url]]
translation:
在距离大城市不远的一座小村庄里…
村庄外围被海洋与森林环绕，那里独自住着一名画家。

他名叫胜，以春日野翔吾为笔名从事创作。

他虽然算不上声名显赫，绘画才能却颇具潜力。
为了远离城镇的喧嚣、放松身心，他来到这里，让时间引领自己走上成为职业画家的道路。

一个沐浴在美丽月光下的夜晚，他的人生即将发生巨大变化。
一切始于一颗流星…不，是陨石？

正当他悠闲地端着茶杯品茶时，一架UFO突然坠毁在自家庭院里。

飞船里显然应该坐着外星访客，可当胜发现来者竟是一对双胞胎姐妹时，还是愣住了。

这对外星姐妹在地球上无依无靠，外表又像幼儿，胜实在无法放任她们自生自灭，只好决定担负起养父的职责。

就这样，胜开始与世上最古怪的外星双胞胎姐妹共同生活，努力把两个淘气的小孩子培养成优秀的女孩。

[翻译自[url=https://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/mil/mf_top.htm]官方网站[/url]]
